geometry.shape: Four coarse overlapping crowd-pair volumes and one source-outline volume per narrow card. Original alpha cuts all gaps. No separate anatomy, clothing relief or added material slots.
geometry.registration: Inverse projection of renderer-clamped source UV anchors; caps/sides split at original crowd U seam.
geometry.rear: Same source motif on the shallow reverse; this is a cutout volume, not new anatomical character geometry.

review: Eight spectators and source clothing/poses retained. Narrow motifs reconstructed as camera operators within source masks; exact face/equipment separation is unclear in the original. Earlier generic people/microphone/operator layouts were rejected. Original orange/yellow bag-like motif at third-pair feet restored in the final crowd image.
